perspective: Understand the main persisted data entities, their relationships, and the information persisted across a report's lifecycle, in order to modify the persistence layer to support future changes to the management of municipal reports
concerns: What are the main data entities stored by the system?
How are users, reports, locations, categories, states, state changes, internal notes, and notifications related to each other?
Which information must be persisted throughout the lifecycle of a report?
Which parts of the application depend on this persisted information?
